verdict.rationale: Databricks publishes a documented REST API reference (workspace-level APIs, versioned Jobs/SQL APIs with request/response examples), plus CLI, SDKs (Python), and Databricks Connect that all wrap this public API for automation and agentic use, and this is corroborated by a runtime probe confirming a working CLI with a raw `databricks api` REST wrapper. Missing for 10: a live interactive API try-it console or independent third-party API-quality corroboration beyond vendor docs.
